capabilities.reason: TransactWriteItems/TransactGetItems are supported on single-region tables.
limitations: Transactions consume additional read/write capacity (2x writes).

capabilities.reason: DynamoDB Streams capture ordered item-level changes for up to 24 hours.
limitations: Each shard lives at most 24 hours; records expire.
Lambda consumers need ReportBatchItemFailures for partial-batch semantics.

capabilities.reason: ConsistentRead=true is supported on tables and indexes within a region.
limitations: GSI reads are always eventually consistent.
Strong reads consume 2x RCU per item size.

capabilities.reason: Global secondary indexes carry an independent partition key and optional sort key.
limitations: GSI reads are always eventually consistent.
Provisioned mode gives each GSI its own throughput; writes amplify.

capabilities.reason: Local secondary indexes share the base partition key with an alternate sort key.
limitations: LSI item collections are limited to 10 GB per partition key.
LSIs can only be created at table creation time.

capabilities.reason: Global tables default to multi-region eventual consistency (MREC).
limitations: Cross-region replication is asynchronous; last-writer-wins conflict resolution.
Transaction atomicity applies only in the region the transaction was invoked.

capabilities.reason: MRSC mode gives strongly consistent reads across regions with synchronous replication.
limitations: Transactions are not supported on MRSC global tables.
Consistency mode is immutable after table creation.
MRSC tables currently support a bounded replica topology - check current docs.

capabilities.reason: Transaction semantics on a global table depend on its consistency mode (variant MREC|MRSC).
MREC: transactions are atomic only in the invoking region and are not replicated as a unit.
limitations: A cross-region failure can leave regions divergent mid-transaction.

capabilities.reason: MRSC global tables do not support transaction operations.
Cross-region read consistency depends on the global-table mode (variant MREC|MRSC).
MREC replicas are eventually consistent; strong reads hold only within the invoking region.
MRSC provides multi-region strong consistency for reads.
